action.description: Vacuum action to execute. get-supported-actions is a read-only discovery action that does not contact ROS or hardware. Read and readiness actions return product-level vacuum state. start-navigation, start-clean-area, and mission-control actions are simulation-only writes with strict runtime/readiness/capability/active-mission gates. send-command is retained for compatibility but is not a backdoor control path.

backend.description: Vacuum backend. Pass simulation for the TurtleBot4/Nav2 VM backend, or real_vacuum for the Valetudo-backed real-vacuum integration. turtlebot4_nav2 and valetudo are accepted compatibility aliases.

token.description: Optional TensorFleet JWT auth token. Defaults to the token stored by tensorfleet-auth login or TENSORFLEET_JWT config.

vmManagerUrl.description: Optional VM Manager API base URL override. Used with routeMode=vm-manager.

runtimeUrl.description: Optional direct real-vacuum runtime base URL override. Used with routeMode=direct.

routeMode.description: Use vm-manager to call the backend runtime through the VM Manager, or direct to call the runtime host.

timeoutMs.description: Optional HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

includeDiagnostics.description: Include normalized diagnostics in snapshot-style responses. Raw diagnostics remain omitted unless includeRawDiagnostics is also true.

includeRawDiagnostics.description: Include raw backend diagnostics. Use only for debugging; product-facing callers should leave this false.

includePreview.description: For map summary, include lightweight layered preview counts and optionally preview content.

includeGeometry.description: For map targets, include normalized target geometry. Defaults to false to keep responses compact.

command.description: Compatibility command field for action=send-command. send-command is refused as a control backdoor; use explicit gated actions for supported simulation writes.

target.description: Navigation target. Used with action=check-navigation-readiness for read-only preflight and action=start-navigation for gated simulation dispatch.

x.description: Target x coordinate in the normalized map frame.

y.description: Target y coordinate in the normalized map frame.

frameId.description: Optional normalized frame id for the target.

label.description: Optional human label for the target.

area.description: Clean-area rectangle. Used with action=check-clean-area-readiness for read-only preflight and action=start-clean-area for gated simulation dispatch.

type.description: Area shape. Only rectangle is accepted in this rollout.

x.description: Rectangle origin x coordinate in the normalized map frame.

y.description: Rectangle origin y coordinate in the normalized map frame.

width.description: Rectangle width in meters; must be positive.

height.description: Rectangle height in meters; must be positive.

frameId.description: Optional normalized frame id for the area.

label.description: Optional human label for the area.

value.description: Required for command=set_fan_speed and command=set_water_usage. Must match a currently advertised option when options are present.
